title: Nexus RecordCharacterTomResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/characters/{character_id}/tom. Returned only after the carrier CAS and the derivative MindState insert committed atomically; any failure rolls back both writes.

carrier_entry_id.description: Carrier KnowledgeEntry id that was CAS-patched.

revision.description: New carrier revision after the CAS bump (expected_revision + 1).

mind_state_id.description: Derivative MindState row id; its holder_entry_id equals carrier_entry_id.
